items.html: And then Gadlut returns, which is the Neshama, the NHY of Aba and the NHY of Ima. And another clarification is needed for the lights alone — for the Mochin of Yenika that rise upward — and the Mochin of Gadlut come out in the inner NHY; and they enter in seven years, which are from the age of thirteen until twenty.
